dict.string: AI-bot locates existing Claude Code sessions in Terminal for messages, photos, queued input and interruption requested on your TAB5. It also reads and controls Music or Spotify playback. Explicit lock requests use System Events.
AI-bot connects to your paired clock and provides authenticated Wi-Fi fallback on your local network.
AI-bot connects to your USB-paired TAB5 to exchange authenticated display data and device requests over Bluetooth.
AI-bot transcribes audio locally after you start a TAB5 voice session. You can review the transcript before sending or inserting it.
AI-bot uses the selected Mac microphone only when you start a TAB5 voice session that uses it.
